I fixed the crash by adding R8 keep rules to `app/proguard-rules.pro`. I couldn't build or run the app here, so this is verified by reading only.

**Cause:** The release build has `isMinifyEnabled = true` in `app/build.gradle.kts`. R8 strips generic type information, so `CatalogRepository.kt` (`object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}`) couldn't read `List<Book>` at runtime. The obfuscated frame `vn.shelftap.lab.b.a` is a sign of this.

**Change:** The rules file was empty apart from a comment. I added:
- `-keepattributes Signature, InnerClasses, EnclosingMethod, *Annotation*`, which keeps the generic signatures `TypeToken` needs.
- `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` and `-keep,allowobfuscation class * extends ...TypeToken`, which keep `TypeToken` and its anonymous subclasses.
- `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`, so Gson can map `Book`'s fields by name after shrinking.

To confirm, run a release build (`./gradlew assembleRelease`) and load the catalog. The debug build was never affected, since minification is off there.
